title: Playful Woman Throwing Snowball in Winter, 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor portrait capturing a cheerful young woman poised to throw a snowball on a snow-covered hillside. She is bundled up in mid-century cold-weather attire, featuring a headscarf tied around her face, a warm jacket, mittens, and a knee-length pleated skirt. The background reveals bare deciduous trees against a winter landscape, exemplifying informal recreational family snapshots typical of post-World War II America.
